name: v1-cp3-material-safe-preview
title: CP3-G 材料安全预览接口与前端嵌入
description: 为 CP3 审核结果页补齐网页登录用户可安全预览 PDF/图片材料的后端接口与前端嵌入，不暴露 Worker token 或原始 storageKey。
creator: tianqingyuluo
notes: Added during CP3 review after discovering the result page cannot safely embed original PDF/image materials. Keep the work in CP3 because it directly supports reviewer evidence inspection in the initial-review workflow; do not expand into CP4 correction versioning or report export.

meta.unlockCriteria: CP3 login, task visibility, material storage, and review result page are available.
